company.name: Caldermere Pharma Logistics Ltd
company.description: Specialist Good Distribution Practice (GDP) pharmaceutical and medical-device wholesale distributor based at Trafford Park in Manchester, operating under MHRA Wholesale Dealer's Licence (WDA(H)) 12345 and a Home Office Controlled Drugs licence. Delivers prescription medicines, controlled drugs (Schedule 2-5), ambient and cold-chain (+2C to +8C) biologics, vaccines, clinical-trial investigational medicinal products (IMP) and sterile medical devices to NHS hospital pharmacies, community pharmacies, dispensing GP practices, care homes and private clinics across the North West, Yorkshire, the Midlands and Scotland. Runs validated temperature-controlled vans and rigids with continuous datalogging and break-the-chain alerting, plus a controlled-drugs secure courier service. Holds a standard national operator (O) licence (OB1456789) for 40 vehicles across two licensed wholesale sites (Trafford Park, Manchester and Leeds Hunslet). All cold-chain vehicles temperature-mapped and qualified annually to MHRA GDP guidance and PIC/S; ADR-compliant for limited dangerous-goods medical consignments.

notes.author: Dispatch (Trafford Park)
notes.body: MRI run carries one Schedule 2 morphine line for Critical Care. Driver Andrew Holloway briefed: witnessed CD receipt, sign ward register, return signed copy. Cool box pre-conditioned to 5C; do not break the chain at goods-in.

notes.author: Workshop foreman
notes.body: Crafter MA70 PHP off the road with a GAH Frigoblock low-gas fault. Cannot be used for cold-chain until the unit is re-gassed and the load space is re-qualified by ThermAssure. Marked not GDP-qualified in the fleet system.

notes.author: QP delegate
notes.body: Blinded Phase II IMP for Trent Biologics in a -80C dry-ice shipper. Continuous ULT logging and cab CO2 monitoring are mandatory. Witnessed chain-of-custody handover at the Nottingham depot; do not open the shipper in transit under any circumstances.

notes.author: Compliance officer
notes.body: Raymond Akhtar's Driver CPC qualification card expires 31 Aug 2026. Last periodic training module outstanding. Book module 5 (drivers' hours and tachograph) before the end of July to avoid grounding him.

notes.author: Driver DRV-001
notes.body: MRI goods-in busy this morning, brief queue at the cold-chain bay. Door open about a minute during transfer; load-space probe touched 7.1C then recovered. Logged as a within-tolerance excursion, no product impact. Register signed by deputy pharmacist.

notes.author: Dispatch (Trafford Park)
notes.body: Care-home CD courier run for Priya Chandra. SIA-vetted and CD-authorised. Tamper-evident pouches for the Schedule 2 and 3 lines; sign the care-home CD register with the nurse-in-charge at both Eccles and Edgbaston. Lone-worker device must be armed.

notes.author: Driver DRV-007
notes.body: On the Nottingham IMP run the cab CO2 detector alarmed at 640ppm from dry-ice sublimation. Opened the window and increased ventilation; level dropped to 520ppm within a few minutes. Shipper temperature stayed below -76C throughout. Reported on return.

notes.author: Account manager
notes.body: Trent Biologics require full GxP audit trail for every IMP movement: signed chain-of-custody, continuous temperature log download and archive, and witnessed handover. Any deviation must be reported to their trial logistics lead within 24 hours.

notes.author: QA (Trafford Park)
notes.body: MHRA Field Safety Notice FSN-2026-0442: recalled infusion sets lot R2204. 240 units collected from Salford Quays Surgical and quarantined. UDI scanned and reconciled against the recall manifest. Awaiting manufacturer collection from the quarantine cage.

notes.author: Transport manager
notes.body: Daily walkaround on the IMP ULT van flagged a slightly low washer level and a faded nearside marker reflector. Both rectified before dispatch. Fridge and CO2 detector self-test passed. Vehicle fit for the critical IMP run.

notes.author: Driver DRV-005
notes.body: Frozen zone ran a short defrost cycle near Leeds, dipped to -23.1C briefly then recovered to setpoint. Within the validated frozen range for the vaccine load. One harsh-braking event on the A653 when a car pulled out; no load shift, vaccines secure.

notes.author: Dispatch (Trafford Park)
notes.body: Eccles care home: ring the buzzer at the staff entrance, the nurse-in-charge must witness and sign the CD register. MDS trays go to the clinical room, not reception. Cold pouch items straight into the medicines fridge, record the fridge temperature.

notes.author: Account manager
notes.body: Salford Quays sterile device delivery: scan UDI on receipt at Dock 3 and reconcile lot numbers and expiry against the manifest. Check the sterile-barrier packaging is intact on every pallet; reject and photograph any compromised packs.

findings.fridgeUnit: GAH Frigoblock low gas, will not hold setpoint
findings.action: Re-gas and re-map before return to cold-chain service
